questions.text: What is the register map of c12_nexys_pwm_audio_top: the offset, width, reset value and access (RW, RO, WO) of every register the host reads or writes?
questions.default: [{name: SAMPLE, offset: 0, access: RW, reset: 0}, {name: GAIN, offset: 4, access: RW, reset: 2068}, {name: SAMPLE_OUT, offset: 8, access: RO, reset: 0}]
questions.reason: The shell owns a 0x80-0xFF window; window_base 0x00 uses the beginning of that window. Relative register offsets are proposed in assumption A-2.
questions.answer:
SAMPLE: offset 0x00, RW, reset 0: [15:0] audio sample, two's complement; [31:16] read 0
GAIN: offset 0x01, WO, reset 0: [15:0] a write sets the gain register (values above 8192 give 8192); the register cannot be read back; reads 0
SOUT: offset 0x02, RO, reset 0: [15:0] sample_out = sample after the gain, two's complement; [31:16] read 0

unmapped: offsets not listed read 0; writes to them and to RO registers are ignored
